title: Sunder to Earthshatter Berserker

stages.title: Act 1 · Ground Slam
stages.goal: Use Ground Slam with Added Fire Damage and Ruthless. Equip a two-handed axe or mace.

stages.title: Act 1 · Sunder swap
stages.goal: Switch to Sunder after The Siren’s Cadence. Keep upgrading your weapon base.

stages.title: Campaign · Sunder links
stages.goal: Pick up Fist of War after The Eternal Nightmare. Add warcries and level Earthshatter in a spare socket.

stages.title: 1 - 75 - Early Mapping
stages.goal: Start maps with Sunder and upgrade your physical axe.

stages.title: 2 - 93 - Red Maps - Ele AIlment Immunity, Rare Helmet
stages.goal: Improve ailment protection and spell damage mitigation before raising map difficulty.

stages.title: 3 - 94 - Echoes of Creation
stages.goal: Switch when you can sustain Echoes of Creation and the warcry rotation.

stages.title: 4 - 96 - Clusters + Echoes, Pre-Mageblood
stages.goal: Add clusters and test the boss setup before investing in more expensive pieces.

overview:
Start with Ground Slam, then use a high-physical-damage axe with Sunder. Earthshatter adds a more involved warcry rotation.

Source guide by Evilwizzer: https://www.reddit.com/r/PathOfExileBuilds/comments/1xuiyez/330_earthshatter_berserker_league_starter_to_ubers/
Original PoB: https://pobb.in/-qaBw-u7dKYl

Passive trees converted with the 3.30 PoB development build. See the creator guide for assumptions and any additional stages.
